verdict.summary: The refactor centralizes native dependency-summary validation without changing fail-closed behavior, and the new warning path is correctly limited to well-formed native summaries whose open-blocker count differs from validated legacy markers. Absent and malformed summaries are deliberately excluded from duplicate drift warnings, counts remain the max of both channels, and the added self-tests cover native-only, marker-only, agreement, closed markers, absent/malformed summaries, and unchanged dispatch counts. No correctness, security, or test-validity defect is apparent in the diff.
